name: compose a candidate from memory with random adjustment
mechanism: build each new candidate coordinate-wise by copying a value from a remembered set of good candidates with some probability (then nudging it) or drawing it fresh, and replace the worst remembered candidate if the new one is better

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Harmony search (HS)' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: a metaheuristic algorithm mimicking the improvisation process of musicians

requires: a memory size and copy/nudge rates (policy)
fails_when: shown to be a re-parametrised evolution strategy; nothing mechanistically new beyond the memory-replacement rule
